test_environment.cache_control: no cache clearing; probe prewarming plus repeated queries; not true cold-cache testing
test_environment.latency_definition: skill elapsed_ms is HTTP through full response read, excludes CLI startup and response projection; chain wall includes driver/skill/serialization/bookkeeping, excludes answer composition
test_environment.percentile_method: nearest rank ceil(n*p); n=3 per question, n=15 per resource; descriptive percentiles only
